title: Casa Blanco
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at “Casa Blanco”, a luxury 9-bed, 8.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 32 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Private Heated Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $100 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Gulf Views - Short Walk to The Beach - Game Room - 6 Adult Bikes - 6 Passenger Golf Cart This beautifully designed coastal retreat blends elevated style with laid-back beach living, offering Gulf views and a prime location just a short walk from the sugar-white sands. Thoughtful architectural details, beaded chandeliers, woodgrain cabinetry, and pecky cypress ceilings which create a warm, sophisticated atmosphere throughout the home. Step outside to your private heated pool, perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach. (Pool heat available for an additional $100 per day from October 1 – May 1.) The outdoor space is ideal for gathering, unwinding, and enjoying the coastal breeze. Inside, the home is designed for both comfort and entertainment. The game room features a classic PAC-MAN arcade, while the chef-inspired kitchen is as functional as it is beautiful, so inviting you’ll actually look forward to making breakfast. Spacious living areas make it easy for everyone to spread out and enjoy time together. To make getting around effortless, the home includes six adult bikes and a six-passenger golf cart for quick trips around the area. Complimentary beach service is also provided from March 1 through October 31 and includes two chairs and one umbrella, making your beach days simple and stress-free. Additional conveniences include on-site parking for up to eight vehicles, making this home an excellent choice for families or groups seeking both luxury and ease. Whether you’re lounging poolside, exploring the area, or taking in the Gulf views, this home offers everything you need for an unforgettable beach getaway. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS FIRST FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: King Bed w/ two Twin bunks above, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only - Bunk Room: Three Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - Bunk Room: Four Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds with Two Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only **During peak season, all of our properties are rented with a 7-night minimum from Saturday to Saturday.**
